title: Cellular Inference Mesh: Salabim DES of edge-cloud LLM inference under PACELC saturation
description: Discrete-event simulation in Salabim of the Cellular Inference Mesh edge-cloud architecture for industrial multilingual AGV voice command processing under PACELC. Implements 300 Monte-Carlo replicates × 3 scenarios × 2 arms × 1800 simulated seconds, with parametric variation per replicate over realistic operational ranges. Verifies Theorem (Pareto-efficiency over 5 axes against 256 sub-compositions and 7 external architectures) and articulates the Saturated Pipeline Conjecture (Flores, 2026) explaining structural insensitivity of percentile-99 latency to fallback-rate reductions under edge saturation. Reproducibility guaranteed via SHA-256 hash chain, seed_canonical=42, 53 pytest tests with bit-parity.
notes: Bit-parity verified: shasum -a 256 output/results.json must equal 1f1e5a121177e8d3963b3599c2d6d9a4a5842b4eeb689cc259136d0a8d6c55f8. See docs/hash-chain.md for the complete SHA-256 audit trail.
